Reviewed unchanged gateway, current-boot, roster and readiness fences; guest broker retains existing port and ordering, and handbook separates passed image/parser checks from pending service runtime.

Reviewed existing broker and direnv closure with unchanged Audi account-origin and current-authority checks; typed four-family browser fixture keeps recurring probe names and credentials unchanged and runtime evidence pending.

Reviewed new immutable Arch/Alma editor package pairs, offline closure database and GC roots, capacity and file/unit safety; actual-image and distribution-parser checks pass with no new host-service placement.

Reviewed ADR0153 carried through ADR0158, new foreign-Linux architecture review and exact OS matrix/scenario/security evidence; package checks and isolated properties pass while browser and replacement-image CLI execution remain pending and accepted ADR statuses stay partial.
